mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE above 4.5%) triggers negative returns as investors anticipate economic slowdown and recession, based on labor market weakness.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Conflicting signals from rising federal funds rates (monetary tightening) and increasing unemployment (labor market weakness) create uncertainty, leading to negative returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite both FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE increasing.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in GDP demand (GDPC1) signals an impending slowdown, prompting positive returns as investors anticipate a pullback.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when GDPC1 drops in late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment (PAYEMS) weakens labor market confidence, prompting negative returns over 20 days as investors expect economic contraction.
Deflation (CPIAUCSL falling below 2.0) triggers positive returns via anticipated rate cuts, affecting S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when CPIAUCSL crosses below 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (GDPC1) alongside robust supply (INDPRO) creates inflationary pressures, leading to negative returns over 60 days as market adjusts to potential overheating.
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive despite rising GDPC1 and INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, a drop in retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening momentum, prompting positive returns as investors expect a correction over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when RSAFS drops in post-shock recovery.
